description: issue #691 (rubber-duck finding): validation is strictly left-to-right, so an earlier bad element wins over the trailing odd-length structural error. `["c4" 0 "e4"]` is odd-length AND has a non-positive duration `0` in the first pair; the `0` duration `ol-range` is reported, not the odd-length one. Locks the earliest-error-wins decision as a fixture.
